purpose: Teach: 澆/椶/僂/彡/シーク/同省/未確認/西方

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、農学の澆水、つまり澆灌の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on irrigation in agriculture—or rather, water management systems in farming, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, professional curiosity. Opens gently with the student's name. Steady pace, measured tone. The kind of teacher who remembers what you said last semester.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、椶櫚、つまり椶の植物分類研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused my paper on palm trees, specifically their botanical classification and growth patterns.
lines.style: Careful, earnest response. Slight pause before diving into the specifics. Speaks with quiet precision, wanting to get the details right. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、僂佝、つまり僂の姿勢病の医学史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered the medical history of postural deformities—kyphosis and similar spinal conditions, yes?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Reflective lilt at the end. The teacher checking her own notes, making sure she understood. Warm attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、漢字の彡、つまり彡偏の書道研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my research examined the kanji radical for hair, the san character, and its evolution in calligraphy and writing systems.
lines.style: Patient clarification. Speaks with understated precision. A slight lift of relief that he's correcting the misunderstanding kindly. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、シーク教徒、つまりシーク派の宗教研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, so your paper was on Sikhism—the Sikh faith and its religious practices and history, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, checking again. Softer tone this time, as if recognizing a pattern. A teacher genuinely trying to keep up with a student's breadth. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、同省、つまり同省内文書の行政研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—actually, I wrote about internal ministry documents and administrative systems within government bureaucracy.
lines.style: Quiet correction, but not correcting her—clarifying his own focus. Speaks with modest certainty. The student who has thought deeply about this. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、未確認生物、つまりUMA研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored cryptozoology in your paper—unconfirmed creatures, UMA research—is that right?
lines.style: A touch of gentle humor now. The teacher who has learned her student's interests don't follow a line. Warm, almost conspiratorial. Slight rise of amusement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、西方浄土、つまり西方の仏教観研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined Pure Land Buddhism, specifically the Western Buddhist cosmology and its theological interpretations.
lines.style: Final answer, delivered with quiet completion. Confident now, having corrected gently several times. The relief of finishing. Warm close, direct eye contact implied.
